recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-26670 unless a future BR&R decision changes MarketingStatus cardinalities again.
issue_request: FHIR-26670 was a Published/Persuasive BR&R R5 change request to make MarketingStatus.country and MarketingStatus.dateRange optional because they are not always known or needed, while keeping MarketingStatus.status mandatory at 1..1.
initial_application: Commit ca1c5a0cfde08c6b0f6e93dcfbcd82f447dd48fb, "Made several mandatory attributes 0..1 FHIR#26670", changed MarketingStatus.country and MarketingStatus.dateRange from 1..1 to 0..1 in source/datatypes/marketingstatus.xml.
additional_context: MarketingStatus is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini as a datatype with a type page and normative status. MedicinalProductDefinition, PackagedProductDefinition, and ManufacturedItemDefinition reference the MarketingStatus datatype rather than redefining its inner cardinalities. BR&R 2020-05-05 minutes independently record the decision as making only status mandatory with a 9-0-0 vote. Later MarketingStatus commits touched descriptions but did not require a cardinality correction.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/datatypes/marketingstatus.xml already has MarketingStatus.country 0..1, MarketingStatus.status 1..1, and MarketingStatus.dateRange 0..1.
